description: Neutralizes ByteDance AppLog user tracking, APM/Npth/Heimdallr crash monitors, AppsFlyer attribution, and Firebase analytics.
name: Unified Telemetry & Tracker Silencer

description: Rewrites Dalvik const-string URL/host literals matching a user-supplied hosts blocklist to a sink IP (default 0.0.0.0). The blocklist file is read at patch time, so daily DNS updates apply without patch releases.
name: Universal Hosts Blocker

options.description: Path to a hosts or plain-domain blocklist file on the patching machine (e.g. Hagezi native.tiktok-onlydomains.txt). Leave empty to skip.
options.title: Hosts blocklist file

options.description: IPv4 address replacing blocked hosts inside const-string literals (e.g. '0.0.0.0').
options.title: Sink IP address

options.description: When enabled, a blocklist entry also matches its subdomains (entry 'example.com' matches 'a.example.com').
options.title: Match subdomains

description: Strips non-essential tracking, crash reporting, and debug companion native libraries in lib/** (e.g. libcrashlytics, libsentry, libbugly, libgwp-asan) by zeroing bytes in-situ.
name: Universal Native Binary Trimmer

options.description: Zero native crash reporting and tracking libraries (Crashlytics, Sentry, Bugly, PLCrashReporter).
options.title: Trim Crash Reporting Libraries

options.description: Zero debug memory and profiling libraries (GWP-ASan, Simpleperf, Android Studio profilers).
options.title: Trim Debug & Profiling Libraries

description: Forces offline execution across any application by revoking INTERNET and network permissions from AndroidManifest.xml and blocking cleartext HTTP traffic at the OS level.
name: Universal Offline Mode

options.description: Also remove ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE and ACCESS_WIFI_STATE permissions. Default is false to prevent SecurityException crashes in apps that query network status without error handling.
options.title: Strip Network State Permissions

options.description: Remove CHANGE_NETWORK_STATE, CHANGE_WIFI_STATE, CHANGE_WIFI_MULTICAST_STATE, and NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES permissions.
options.title: Strip Wi-Fi Control Permissions

options.description: Remove Google Cloud Messaging and Firebase Cloud Messaging push receiver permissions (com.google.android.c2dm.permission.RECEIVE).
options.title: Strip Push Notification Permissions

options.description: Remove Google Services Framework and account sync permissions (com.google.android.providers.gsf.permission.READ_GSERVICES, android.permission.GET_ACCOUNTS).
options.title: Strip Google Services Sync Permissions

options.description: Enforce android:usesCleartextTraffic='false' on the application tag in AndroidManifest.xml.
options.title: Block Cleartext Traffic

description: Selectively strips sensitive privacy, sensor, and hardware permissions from AndroidManifest.xml via configurable boolean toggles.
name: Universal Privacy Permissions Stripper

options.description: Remove POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission (Android 13+) from AndroidManifest.xml.
options.title: Strip Notification Permission

options.description: Remove CAMERA permission from AndroidManifest.xml.
options.title: Strip Camera Permission

options.description: Remove RECORD_AUDIO and audio capture permissions from AndroidManifest.xml.
options.title: Strip Microphone Permissions

options.description: Remove external storage (READ/WRITE/MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) and media permissions (READ_MEDIA_IMAGES, READ_MEDIA_VIDEO, READ_MEDIA_AUDIO, ACCESS_MEDIA_LOCATION) from AndroidManifest.xml.
options.title: Strip Storage & Media Permissions

options.description: Remove ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, and ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION permissions from AndroidManifest.xml.
options.title: Strip Location Permissions

options.description: Remove READ_CONTACTS, WRITE_CONTACTS, and GET_ACCOUNTS permissions from AndroidManifest.xml.
options.title: Strip Contacts & Accounts Permissions

options.description: Remove READ_CALENDAR and WRITE_CALENDAR permissions from AndroidManifest.xml.
options.title: Strip Calendar Permissions

options.description: Remove Bluetooth scanning/connection and nearby Wi-Fi permissions (BLUETOOTH_SCAN, BLUETOOTH_CONNECT, BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE, NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES, UWB_RANGING) from AndroidManifest.xml.
options.title: Strip Nearby Devices Permissions

options.description: Remove BODY_SENSORS, BODY_SENSORS_BACKGROUND, and ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION permissions from AndroidManifest.xml.
options.title: Strip Body Sensors Permissions

description: Prevents applications from overriding display brightness (such as in-app brightness sliders, barcode/QR full-screen brightness, or window-level overrides) by neutralizing all direct writes to WindowManager.LayoutParams.screenBrightness.
name: Universal Screen Brightness Governor

description: Forces the target application to respect system screen timeout and sleep timers by neutralizing keepScreenOn view calls and stripping FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON from windows and layout parameters.
name: Universal Screen Timeout Enforcer

description: Neutralizes FLAG_SECURE on windows, layout params, and SurfaceViews, unlocks audio playback capture, and suppresses Android 14+ screenshot and screen recording detection callbacks.
name: Universal Screenshot Protection Bypass

description: Neutralizes third-party APM, crash reporting, analytics, attribution, session replay, location tracking, and push engagement SDK init and event methods at DEX level via early return-void; companion runtime layer to Universal Telemetry Neutralizer (manifest layer).
name: Universal SDK Blocker

options.description: Neutralize New Relic, Datadog, and Dynatrace monitoring, metric reporting, and HTTP transaction tracing methods.
options.title: Block APM & Performance Monitoring SDKs

options.description: Neutralize Raygun, Shake, Embrace, Splunk Mint, App Center, OpenTelemetry, ACRA, Sentry, Bugsnag, Crashlytics (legacy and Firebase), Fabric, Instabug, Countly, and HockeyApp crash reporters.
options.title: Block Crash Reporting SDKs

options.description: Neutralize Firebase Analytics, Matomo, Leanplum, Localytics, WebEngage, PostHog, MoEngage, Snowplow, mParticle, Treasure Data, Huawei Analytics, Yandex Metrica, Facebook AppEvents, and Sensors Analytics event tracking, capture, and session logging methods.
options.title: Block Analytics SDKs

options.description: Neutralize AppsFlyer, Adjust, Amplitude, Mixpanel, CleverTap, Segment, Branch, Singular, Kochava, Tenjin, Unity Analytics, Flurry, and GameAnalytics conversion, tracking, and attribution SDKs.
options.title: Block Attribution & Engagement SDKs

options.description: Neutralize pre-Firebase Google Analytics tracking, hit dispatching, and activity reporting methods (com.google.analytics and com.google.android.gms.analytics).
options.title: Block Legacy Google Analytics

options.description: Neutralize OneSignal, Airship, and Braze push engagement and tagging SDKs. WARNING: this breaks push notification delivery; enable only to fully silence push engagement SDK runtimes.
options.title: Block Push Engagement SDKs (WARNING: Breaks Push)

options.description: Neutralize UXCam, Smartlook, FullStory, Contentsquare, and Bugsee screen and session recording SDK methods.
options.title: Block Session Replay SDKs

options.description: Neutralize Radar, Gimbal, and Estimote beacon and location tracking SDKs; note OS location permission controls remain the primary gate.
options.title: Block Location & Beacon Tracking SDKs

description: Strips advertising and Privacy Sandbox permissions, disables analytics ContentProviders and telemetry background services (Firebase, Sentry, Adjust, AppsFlyer, DataTransport), prunes ComponentDiscovery registrars, and injects telemetry opt-out metadata. Includes an optional toggle to disable push notification services.
name: Universal Telemetry Neutralizer

options.description: Remove AD_ID, Privacy Sandbox attribution/topics/audiences, and Play Install Referrer permissions from AndroidManifest.xml.
options.title: Revoke Advertising & Tracking Permissions

options.description: Disable analytics ContentProviders (Google Measurement, Sentry, Facebook, Flurry, Branch, AppsFlyer).
options.title: Disable Telemetry ContentProviders

options.description: Disable Google Measurement, Google DataTransport, Firebase Sessions, and AppsFlyer background job services.
options.title: Disable Telemetry Background Services

options.description: Disable install referrer and analytics measurement broadcast receivers (Adjust, AppsFlyer, Google Measurement).
options.title: Disable Telemetry Receivers

options.description: Inject meta-data opt-out entries into application tag (Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance, AppsFlyer, Sentry, Facebook SDK) and prune Firebase discovery registrars.
options.title: Inject Telemetry Opt-Out Flags & Prune Registrars

options.description: Disable com.google.firebase.provider.FirebaseInitProvider. Default is false to prevent issues in apps that depend on Firebase Auth or push notifications.
options.title: Disable Firebase Init Provider

options.description: Disable Meta Fbns, PushLite, and Firebase Cloud Messaging services plus push receivers (Firebase IID, Braze). WARNING: this breaks push notifications; enable only to fully silence background push delivery.
options.title: Disable Push Notification Services

options.description: Disable legacy Google Analytics background services and receivers (distinct from Firebase AppMeasurement, which is covered by the telemetry toggles above).
options.title: Disable Google Analytics Services

options.description: Disable Meta Analytics2/OneFabric upload services, Instagram upload scheduler receiver, and deferred analytics worker components.
options.title: Disable Meta Analytics Upload Pipeline

options.description: Disable Lacrima lock-screen/shutdown crash detectors, crash-loop state trackers, and background crash-dump upload services. User-initiated bug reports are untouched.
options.title: Disable Crash Detectors & Dump Upload

options.description: Disable attribution, FDID/PhoneId/USDiD, and FamilyApps cross-app identity providers plus referrer and cross-signing components. WARNING: may break login, account switching, and deferred deep links; enable only to fully silence device-identity collection.
options.title: Disable Device-ID & Cross-App Identity Providers

options.description: Disable Google ML Kit InitProvider, ComponentDiscoveryService, and prune related registrars. WARNING: Breaks on-device barcode scanning, face detection, and text recognition.
options.title: Disable ML Kit On-Device Vision

options.description: Remove ad SDK auto-init entries (e.g. Unity Ads) from the androidx.startup InitializationProvider. WARNING: may break rewarded ads and ad-gated features; enable only to block SDK auto-initialization.
options.title: Disable Ad SDK Startup Initializers

description: Losslessly strips non-rendering metadata and ancillary chunks (EXIF, XMP, ICCP) from WebP assets across res/ and assets/ to reduce APK size.
name: Universal WebP Asset Optimizer

options.description: Remove camera parameters, geolocation, and creator metadata chunks from WebP images.
options.title: Strip EXIF Metadata

options.description: Remove Adobe XMP XML metadata chunks from WebP images.
options.title: Strip XMP Metadata

options.description: Remove ICCP color profile chunks. Default is false to preserve color profile fidelity on wide-gamut displays.
options.title: Strip ICC Color Profiles

description: Unlocks local Hevy Pro capabilities (unlimited workout routines, routine folders, advanced graphs, and local analytics) by dynamically enabling Pro getters and suppressing grace period payment warnings in Hermes Bytecode (HBC96).
name: Unlock Pro

description: Neutralizes background update polling tasks and device ID check routines to prevent forced update popups.
name: Update Prompt Suppressor

description: Adjusts video display aspect ratio across feeds and story cells: 'fit' ensures the entire video is visible without cropping, or 'fill' expands the video to fill the screen.
name: Video Fit

options.description: Aspect ratio mode for feed and story videos: 'fit' (entire video visible without crop), or 'fill' (crop to fill screen).
options.title: Video Fit Mode

description: Caps video playback resolution (1080p, 720p, 540p, 480p, 360p) to conserve battery, GPU/MediaCodec load, and mobile data. Download quality is controlled separately by the Media Usability patch (downloadQuality).
name: Video Quality Governor

options.description: Select maximum video playback resolution ceiling: 1080 (1080p ExtremelyHigh), 720 (720p SuperHigh), 540 (540p H_High), 480 (480p High), or 360 (360p Standard).
options.title: Maximum Playback Resolution

options.description: Drops ByteVC2 renditions from playback bitrate lists when an H.264 or ByteVC1 alternative exists, so videos use the hardware decoder instead of TikTok's CPU-bound ByteVC2 software decoder.
options.title: Avoid ByteVC2 Software Decoding

options.description: When the ladder's lowest video stream exceeds the device hardware decoder capability (queried via MediaCodecList), drops video streams and keeps audio-only instead of entering decoder-reject retry loops that freeze the device.
options.title: Drop Undecodable Video Streams

description: Strips on-device voice recognition and speech synthesis engines (libspeechspg.so, libspeechsdk.so) and their loader stubs (libspeechengine.so, libspeechepg.so) to save APK space. Breaks voice search (microphone button), voice input, and editor text-to-speech/sing features.
name: Voice & Speech Engine De-bloat

description: All store purchases (coins, gems, no-ads, characters, deals, potions and perks) are granted instantly and free without Google Play billing, online or offline. The shop, deals and perks tabs keep loading their full catalogue with no network connection, and real-money store items stay visible offline, where Google Play billing never reports prices.
name: Temple Run 2 Free IAP

description: Every ad-gated reward works without watching an ad and without a network connection: rewarded-map unlocks, potions, power-ups, dailies, battle pass, advent calendar, weekly rewards and rewarded boosts are granted instantly.
name: Temple Run 2 Instant Rewards

description: Shows on a profile whether that person follows you back, and marks accounts in your follow lists that don't. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.
name: Show follow status

description: Adds TikTok's search button inside the LIVE section where TikTok supports it, so you can look for LIVEs. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
name: Show LIVE search

description: Shows the progress bar on videos where TikTok hides it, so you can see how long a video is and skip around. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
name: Show the progress bar

description: Shows a small preview picture while you drag the progress bar, so you can find the part you want. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
name: Show the progress bar thumbnail

description: Makes TikTok see the SIM country and carrier you choose. It may not change your region, since TikTok also goes by your internet connection and account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region.
name: SIM spoof

description: Plays videos without the warning screen you'd have to tap through first, and can hide the Check sources banner on unverified videos. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
name: Skip content warnings

description: Skips TikTok's setup screens on a fresh install, like the interest picker and the swipe tutorial. Sign-in and age screens still show. Its switch is on once picked, since setup runs before you can reach settings. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.
name: Skip first-launch setup

description: Stops the full-screen ad TikTok can show while it starts up. It has no switch, so only patching again without it brings the ad back.
name: Skip the splash ad

description: Stops two background tasks TikTok uses to check for updates, one of them when your phone starts. Some in-app update prompts may stop. Play Store updates still work. It has no switch, so only patching again undoes it.
name: Skip update checks

description: When a video ends in TikTok's full screen view, it stays on that video instead of moving to the next one. Swiping still moves on. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
name: Stay on the video in full screen

description: Stops TikTok's built-in AI engine from starting, so it doesn't get a copy of everything TikTok logs about your use. TikTok works as if the engine weren't there. It has no switch, so only patching again without it undoes it.
name: Stop on-device AI profiling

description: Stops TikTok adding the videos you watch to your Watch history. The catch: your views stop counting, and For You learns less about what you like. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
name: Stop recording watch history

description: Stops TikTok saving your new searches on your phone. Older searches stay until you delete them, and TikTok's servers may keep their own record. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
name: Stop saving search history

description: Stops videos in search results from playing by themselves. Each one shows its cover until you open it, so searching stays quiet. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
name: Stop search autoplay

description: Stops a video at its end instead of playing it again. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
name: Stop video looping

description: Lets a story replay when it ends instead of moving on, and keeps a photo story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
name: Story controls

description: Lets you make captions bigger, change their background and keep them in clear display, and save subtitle files with downloaded videos. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, and Downloads for subtitle files.
name: Subtitle tools

description: Lets a left swipe on a video open its comments or do nothing, instead of opening the creator's profile. Starts off. Pick an action in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
name: Swipe-left controls

description: Translates comments as they load, using TikTok's own translator, so you don't have to tap Translate on each one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments, where a second row lists languages TikTok's automatic translation should leave alone.
name: Translate comments

description: Lets TikTok trust security certificates you install yourself, so a tool like mitmproxy can show what the app sends. The risk: anyone who gets a certificate onto your phone can read TikTok's traffic too. Use it only on a test phone.
name: Trust user certificates

description: Stops the little vibrations TikTok makes when you tap or hold things. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
name: Turn off haptics

description: Opens and closes TikTok's screens without the sliding animation, so moving around feels quicker. Swipes still follow your finger. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
name: Turn off screen transitions

description: Shows search results that aren't tailored to your account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
name: Use non-personalized search

description: Shows TikTok's text in your phone's own font instead of TikTok's, and can use your phone's emoji too. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.
name: Use system font

description: Helps Google sign-in work in the patched app by naming Pinterest's original signature. It only helps with microG-RE or the XSpoofSignatures module. Email sign-in doesn't need it. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
name: Spoof signature for Google sign-in

description: Removes tracking tags from links you copy or share from Pinterest. The link still goes to the same place, and short pin.it links stay as they are. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.
name: Strip link tracking

description: Uses Android's own share menu when you share a pin link. Screenshot and download actions work as before. Good if you want your usual share targets. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.
name: System share sheet

description: Coin save reads always return ~1.34 billion coins (native libil2cpp.so patch on Org.TotalCoins).
name: Unlimited coins

description: Your cash, gold and diamonds always show the maximum. You never run short of money.
name: Unlimited currency

description: Loads the unlimited money save into the game the first time you open it.
name: Unlimited money (restore save)

description: Packs the special save file (unlimited coins & gems, everything unlocked) inside the app.
name: Unlimited money (save bundle)

description: Free coins forever. Your point balance always reads as the maximum, so you can afford anything in the shop. You can still spend and save normally.
name: Unlimited Points

description: Spoofs rewarded ad callbacks to grant coins/rewards without showing ads.
name: Vector Ad Spoof

description: Spending money increases your balance instead of decreasing it (native libil2cpp.so patch).
name: Vector Money Mod

description: Unlocks Days Matter Pro by forcing the pro flag to true.
name: Unlock Pro Features

description: Forces the 'is_pro_user' check to always return true, unlocking Pro features in Device Info.
name: Unlock Pro Features

description: Forces 'proActivated' and 'subscriptionActivated' to true, unlocking Pro features in Music Pitcher Radio.
name: Unlock Pro Features

description: Unlocks Pro features in Video Guru by forcing the premium check method a()Z to return true.
name: Unlock Pro Features

description: Unlocks Huanxiu SVIP by forcing getSvipStatus to return 3 (SVIP).
name: Unlock SVIP Features

description: Unlocks Telegram Premium features by forcing isPremium() to return true.
name: Unlock Telegram Premium

description: Unlocks VIP features in Wearfit Pro by forcing getIsVip() to return 1.
name: Unlock VIP Features

description: Fixes Wear Engine scope authorization errors by forcing the error code check to succeed. WARNING: May cause crashes.
name: Wear Engine Scope Fix (Experimental)

description: Fixes Wear Engine scope authorization errors in Photex Companion by forcing the error code check to succeed. WARNING: May cause crashes.
name: Wear Engine Scope Fix (Experimental)

description: Restores media controls using Android notification access. Includes Enable phone support.
name: Enable media controls

description: Runs Samsung Daily Board on phones with launcher, screen layout and crash fixes. Optional features are separate patches.
name: Enable phone support

description: Forces Instagram notifications into one group, or into separate groups by notification category.
name: Force notification grouping

options.description: Choose whether every Instagram notification uses one notification group or separate groups by category.
options.title: Grouping mode

options.description: Print notification grouping decisions to logcat.
options.title: Debug logging

options.description: When grouping all notifications together, remove sort keys and conversation hints that can make Android or One UI split Instagram notifications anyway.
options.title: Strict all-notifications grouping

description: Replaces Samsung weather with Open-Meteo using approximate location. Includes Enable phone support.
name: Use Open-Meteo weather

description: Treats wireless charging or charging in landscape as a dock and updates the charging labels. Includes Enable phone support.
name: Use phone charging as dock

description: Shows images, GIFs and videos linked in comments and text posts inline.
name: Inline comment images

description: Stops a swipe right on the home feed from opening the camera. The camera button and deep links still open it.
name: Disable swipe to camera

description: Adds a download button beside the save icon on feed posts and reels and beside the reply pill on stories. Posts with several media open a bottom sheet to pick what to save.
name: Downloads

description: Lets you watch stories, Instants and messages without being marked as seen. Each surface has its own toggle in Piko settings.
name: Ghost mode

description: Removes sponsored posts and ad units from the main feed.
name: Hide feed ads

description: Stops Instagram from inserting ads into Reels and Stories. The same ad injector also feeds Explore and the contextual feeds, so they stay ad-free too.
name: Hide reels and stories ads

description: Return a random advertising ID instead of the real one, so the app has no advertising identifier to hand to Pinterest or to any bundled tracker.
name: Neutralize advertising ID

description: Make the app see an empty contact list, so nothing is shown from your address book and nothing can be matched or uploaded from it.
name: Return an empty contact list

description: Stop uploading your call history to Truecaller's servers, and stop it reading the system call log to do so.
name: Stop call history sync

description: Bypass Gboard signature whitelist checks and force them to pass.
name: Add Gboard Signature Bypass

description: Enable Advanced Voice Typing with automatic punctuation and rambler mode.
name: Advanced Voice Typing

description: Enable AI writing tools with support for all languages.
name: AI Writing Tools

description: Rename the package to com.akshaykadam.pixelboard and allow a custom app name so it can be installed alongside the official Gboard.
name: Package Rename

description: Fixes imgur albums crashing or failing to load when patched alongside the official ReVanced rif patches. Does nothing without them.
name: Fix imgur albums

description: Shows images, GIFs and videos linked in comments and text posts inline.
name: Inline comment images

description: Add option to view visible and hidden story mentions.
name: View story mentions

description: Stops a swipe right on the home feed from opening the camera. The camera button and deep links still open it.
name: Disable swipe to camera

description: Adds a download button beside the save icon on feed posts and reels and beside the reply pill on stories. Posts with several media open a bottom sheet to pick what to save.
name: Downloads

description: Lets you watch stories, Instants and messages without being marked as seen. Each surface has its own toggle in Piko settings.
name: Ghost mode

description: Removes sponsored posts and ad units from the main feed.
name: Hide feed ads

description: Stops Instagram from inserting ads into Reels and Stories. The same ad injector also feeds Explore and the contextual feeds, so they stay ad-free too.
name: Hide reels and stories ads

description: Adds a debug option to browse the tweet object in NewX post menus.
name: NewX: Browse tweet object

description: Lays out post action bars with the spacing NewX used before 12.28.0-alpha.04: counted actions share the row width and icon-only actions keep their intrinsic size, so hiding an action never leaves a gap.
name: NewX: Classic inline action spacing

description: Changes the package name and the app name. This allows you to install the patched X alongside the original X or other patched X.
name: NewX: Clone

options.description: A new package name for the patched app.
options.title: Package name

options.description: A new app name (label). Entering "X" will skip changing the app name.
options.title: App name

description: Saves crash logs and shows a notification with share and copy actions.
name: NewX: Crash logs

description: Customise font style
name: NewX: Custom font

description: Allows for using domains like fxtwitter when sharing tweets/posts.
name: NewX: Custom sharing domain

description: Lets you hide selected items from the NewX navigation drawer, and optionally add Messages and Grok shortcuts.
name: NewX: Customize drawer items

description: Lets you hide selected actions from NewX post action bars.
name: NewX: Customize inline actions

description: Lets you hide selected items from the NewX photo and video long-press menu.
name: NewX: Customize media menu items

description: Reorder, hide, and replace NewX bottom navigation bar items.
